claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched four astronauts on a 10-day moon journey at 6:35 p.m. EDT on April 1, 2026, from Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B.
SpaceX is scheduled to launch Starlink 10-58 from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on April 2, 2026 at 7:52 a.m. EDT.
SpaceX Falcon 9 - Starlink 10-58 is scheduled for April 2, 2026 (7:52 a.m. EDT) from Launch Complex 40.
SpaceX Falcon 9 - Northrop Grumman CRS-24 (Space Station Supplies) is scheduled for April 8, 2026 (TBA) from Launch Complex 40.
United Launch Alliance (ULA) - Amazon Leo 5 is scheduled for TBA from Launch Complex 41.
Artemis II is a 10-day crewed mission orbiting the moon.
Artemis II tests technology for future lunar surface landings.
The Space Coast has over 100 planned launches in 2025.
2026 launches on the Space Coast are primarily driven by SpaceX Falcon 9, ULA, and Blue Origin vehicles.
